total.heading: Order total
total.help: In your store's currency. Shoppers paying in another currency see it converted. Leave empty for no limit.

rules.heading: Products and collections
rules.help: Limits for specific products, variants or collections. A limit only applies when the shopper is buying something it covers. "Multiple of" sells in packs, for example 6 for boxes of six.
rules.free: The free plan includes {{count}} rules. Upgrade from the app's page for unlimited rules.
rules.name: Applies to

messages.heading: Messages for shoppers (optional)
messages.help: Leave empty to use the built-in messages, shown in the shopper's language (English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese or Dutch).
messages.paidOnly: Custom messages are part of the paid plan. The built-in messages are shown in the shopper's language.
messages.itemStep: Product not in a multiple of its pack size

problems.max-below-min: The maximum is lower than the minimum.
problems.step-above-max: The pack size is bigger than the maximum, so nothing could be bought.
problems.empty-rule: Set a minimum, a maximum or a multiple, or remove this row.
problems.duplicate: This is already in the list.
problems.target: This item can't be used. Remove it and add it again.
problems.too-many: You can have up to 100 rules.
problems.too-many-collections: You can have up to 100 collections.
problems.too-big: There are too many rules for Shopify to check at checkout. Remove some rules.
problems.plan: This needs the paid plan. Upgrade from the app's page, or remove the extra rules or messages.

errors.fix: Some settings need fixing before they can be saved.
errors.setup: The settings storage couldn't be prepared. Reload the page; if it keeps happening, reinstall the app.
